conclusion: The recorded X2 Voronoi and MedialAxis errors are caused by invalid diagrams around nanometre clipping edges and by reconstructed diagrams exposing stale local storage after a rotation repair. MedialAxis conditionally normalizes only diagnosed invalid input containing sub-tolerance edges, within min(SCALED_EPSILON, 1% of minimum printable width), and validates the replacement before use. Every Voronoi construction overload clears prior repaired storage. Two regression cases fail before repair and pass afterward. Six fixed native slices of X2, Benchy and Vulcan600 have zero geometry warnings/errors and five existing CLI initialization/metadata compatibility warnings each. Benchy and Vulcan600 retain identical complete commands, motion annotations and configuration. X2 actual changes occur only in support-interface commands on 11 layers, plus width annotation changes on three additional layers; model extrusion paths, other features, layer Z values and configuration remain unchanged. Windows exit 0 still does not establish warning-free geometry; inspect native logs.
scope: Version-bound X2 nanometre contact geometry and reusable Voronoi rebuild contract

Temporary diagnostics were removed and existing installed DLL hashes remain unchanged. Checkout anchors do not assert that changed source is committed.
